name: Superboof 1g Pre-Roll
description:
Lineage: Black Cherry Punch x Tropicanna Cookies F2

Breeder: Blockhead Buds

Terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene, Caryophyllene

Effects: Euphoric, Creative, Relaxed

Aroma: Sweet Cherry, Citrusy, Tropical 

Rev your engines with Superboof, a strain that’s built for a high-performance experience. Like a finely tuned engine, this hybrid kicks into gear with a sweet cherry aroma, paired with a sharp citrus tang and a burst of tropical flair. The effects hit fast, delivering a euphoric rush that sparks creativity and focus, followed by a smooth, relaxed glide that keeps you in control. Whether you're cruising through a creative project or just kicking back after a busy day, Superboof keeps you running smooth and steady, with just the right amount of power to take you where you need to go.
